title: Swiping on a phone steers the snake
description: On a phone-sized screen the game opens and plays with no keyboard, and swiping across the board turns the snake without scrolling the page away.

steps.goal: Make the view phone-sized, using device emulation or a narrow window if no real phone is attached. On the Snake game, start a run if one is not already running. Then swipe up across the play area and watch the snake; then swipe left across it and watch; then swipe down across it and watch. While swiping, notice whether the page itself scrolls away from the game or anything breaks.
success: The game was playable on a phone-sized screen with no keyboard
Swiping up turned the snake upward and swiping left turned it leftward, and swiping down turned it downward
The page did not scroll away from the game while swiping, and the run kept going with no error
